question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a yellow ball, Bob has a white ball, Claire has a orange ball, Dave has a purple ball, Eve has a pink ball, Fred has a black ball, and Gertrude has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Fred swap balls. Then, Alice and Eve swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Eve and Fred swap balls. Then, Fred and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Finally, Bob and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Gertrude has the
Options:
(A) yellow ball
(B) white ball
(C) orange ball
(D) purple ball
(E) pink ball
(F) black ball
(G) brown ball
solution:
Ball colors in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: yellow, white, orange, purple, pink, black, brown
1. Dave and Fred swap: yellow, white, orange, black, pink, purple, brown
2. Alice and Eve swap: pink, white, orange, black, yellow, purple, brown
3. Gertrude and Fred swap: pink, white, orange, black, yellow, brown, purple
4. Eve and Fred swap: pink, white, orange, black, brown, yellow, purple
5. Fred and Alice swap: yellow, white, orange, black, brown, pink, purple
6. Dave and Alice swap: black, white, orange, yellow, brown, pink, purple
7. Bob and Alice swap: white, black, orange, yellow, brown, pink, purple
Gertrude has the purple ball, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
